encode_limbs.note: EncodeBase58 keeps the value in little-endian base-58^5 limbs (uint32) and folds three input bytes into it per pass (limb * 2^24 + carry fits in 64 bits), then expands each limb into five digits, instead of one byte per pass over a one-digit-per-byte buffer.

decode_limbs.note: DecodeBase58 keeps the value in little-endian 32-bit limbs and folds five digits into it per pass (58^5 < 2^32), checking max_ret_len after every pass (the byte length only grows, so the accept/reject decision is unchanged), instead of one digit per pass over a one-byte-per-element buffer.
